message.content: {"caption":"Flow diagram of candidate self-edits, downstream evaluation, and reward-guided policy updating.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram. A blue block labeled “Ctx” points to a rounded box labeled “LM” containing θ_t. From this model, three curved, right-pointing branches lead to orange boxes labeled SE₁, SE₂, and SE₃. Each branch continues through a purple “Optimize” box and a loss expression, respectively 𝓛(SE₁, θ_t), 𝓛(SE₂, θ_t), and 𝓛(SE₃, θ_t), then points to an updated-parameter symbol θ′_i. To the right of a vertical divider, three aligned evaluation rows each show “Test,” a blue block, an arrow to an “LM” box containing θ′_i, then an arrow to “Ans” and a blue answer block. The first and second answer rows carry checkmarks; the third carries a cross. Curved connectors group the evaluation outcomes and lead toward policy updating. An upper-right rounded box labeled “RL Data” shows the tuple (Ctx, θ_t, SE, ✓/✗), with “State” under Ctx and θ_t, “Action” under SE, and “Reward” under ✓/✗. Beneath it, “Policy Update” is paired with a coral box containing θ_{t+1}.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
